timing_flags.variable: index constituents at the end of month 120
timing_flags.quote: The panel contains 34,387 monthly observations on 500 stocks that are index constituents at the end of month 120, with history back to month 1 or index-inclusion date.

answer.selection_quote: The sample covers only 120 months and 500 index constituents, so results are conditioned on survivorship and index membership and may not generalize to the broad market.
